evidence.records: docs/ORDERING.md rows 279 / 282 and line 430, docs/M3_R10.md line 880 and docs/R10_VALIDATION.md row 14 give franchised consignment as the fallback for both parts. docs/M3_R10.md line 85 still says U4 is "in JLC stock".

findings.impact: If JLC cannot fill U4 and U9 on order day, 5 boards cannot be fully assembled. The fallback the records give cannot be met from TI, ST, DigiKey, Avnet or Newark today (Mouser and RS unverified). The only listed U9 stock is at brokers. U9 is the battery-path eFuse, so a broker part without traceability is a reliability risk. This is ordering and evidence, not a board defect.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. (1) In ORDERING 8.1 rows 279 / 282, record the franchised status with dates: TI and ST stores out; DigiKey 0 with expected dates of 14-Dec-2026 (U9) and 22-Mar-2027 (U4); Mouser and RS to be checked. (2) State that U9 / U4 come only from franchised sources or JLC with traceability, never from brokers. (3) Add a fallback that does not need new stock: order the boards with U4 / U9 left unfitted (DNP), or order only as many fully fitted boards as JLC can fill (U4 has 2 orderable), and fit the rest later. Both are owner choices. (4) Correct M3_R10.md line 85, "in JLC stock".
